label: GB-dpa-2018 Section 124C

obligations.text:
Impact assessments for codes of practice
(1)
Where a code is prepared under section 121, 122, 123, 124 or 124A, the Commission must carry out and publish an assessment of—
(a)
who would be likely to be affected by the code, and
(b)
the effect the code would be likely to have on them.
